arabic text: QABR MAI AHMED MURSAL KO SATAAIA KISNE
english translation text: WHO TORMENTED PROPHET (PBUH) IN HIS GRAVE?

arabic text: QABR MAI AHMED MURSAL KO SATAAIA KISNE\nFATIMA ZAHRA KO DARBAAR BULAAIA KISNE
english translation text: WHO TORMENTED PROPHET (PBUH) IN HIS GRAVE?\nWHO CALLED BIBI FATIMA (S.A.) TO THE COURT OF THE RULER?

arabic text: NAAM NE LENAI SAI CHUPJAAIE GI TAAREEKH BALAA\nJALTEY DARWAZAI KO ZAHRA PAI GHIRAIA KISNEY
english translation text: WILL HISTORY BE CONCEALED BY NOT NAMING PEOPLE,\nWHO BROKE DOWN THE BURNING DOOR ON FATIMA (S.A.)?

arabic text: JISKE DARWAAZE PE JUKTE HAI MALAAIK AAKEY\nUS KI GHUSTAAKHI KA MANSOO BA BANAAIA KISNE
english translation text: THE ONE AT WHOSE DOOR ANGELS BOW DOWN,\nWHO PLANNED TO BE DISRESPECTFUL TO HER?

arabic text: HAATH MAI LEKAI CHALI FATIMA TEHREER NABI\nCHAAK KARNAI KEYLIYE HAATH BARAAIA KISNE
english translation text: HAZRAT FATIMA (S.A.) WALKED WITH THE LETTER OF THE PROPHET (PBUH) IN HER HAND,\nWHO REFUSED TO ACCEPT THE WILL OF THE PROPHET (PBUH)?

arabic text: AAIA HASNAIN O ALI HAQ KI GAWAAHI KELIYE\nHAQ BAJAANIB THY TAU KHAAMOSH KARAAIA KISNE
english translation text: IMAM ALI (A.S.) AND HASNAIN (A.S) CAME FORWARD TO TESTIFY FOR THE TRUTH,\nTHE TRUTH WAS ON THEIR SIDE, WHO SILENCED THEM?

arabic text: ALMIYA BAAGH FIDAK BAAD MUHAMMAD KAI HUWA\nZEHR KHATOON KAI BABA KO PILAIAA KIS NE
english translation text: THE TRAGEDY OF FADAK HAPPENED AFTER THE PASSING AWAY OF THE PROPHET (S.A),\nWHO HURT THE PROPHET (S.A.) DURING AND AFTER HIS LIFETIME?

arabic text: US PE HIZEYAAN KI TOHMA KOLAGAAIA KISNE\nJISKE NALAAIN KAI SADQEY SAI FAHEM HO HAASIL
english translation text: THE ONE AT WHOSE FEET LIES WISDOM,\nWHO ACCUSED HIM OF NOT BEING IN HIS SENSES?

arabic text: POOCH FAIAAZ FAKAT ITNA SITAMGAR SAI SAWAAL\nALLAI AHMED PAI SITAM DHAANA CIKHAAIA KISNE
english translation text: OH PEOPLE! ASK THE THIS QUESTION TO THE OPPRESSOR,\nWHO OPPRESSED THE FAMILY OF THE PROPHET (PBUH)?
